"'''Deadfall'''" was the callsign of a notorious [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] agent in the employ of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Deadfall specialized in subterfuge, creating chaos on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in advance of an Imperial invasion. [[Havoc Squad]] attacked [[Outpost Shadowstrike]] on [[Voss]] hoping to capture him, but Deadfall [[Death/Legends|died]] in the resulting conflict.
